_comment: The docs' demos (record.py writes a GIF, an MP4 and a WebM each). `scenes` are scripted model replies like scripts/screenshots/scenes.json, kept short so each GIF fits in 15 s; the demo stack loads this file first, then scenes.json, so a demo can also use a screenshot scene. `demos` are the recordings: each one's steps run in order (record.py's Demo methods say what each step does).

scenes.match: Write the changelog entry for the hourly view

steps.say:
Here's the entry.

**Hourly forecast.** The day screen now has an hourly strip: temperature, rain chance and wind for the next 24 hours. Tap an hour to see its details.

**Faster startup.** Forecasts are cached for ten minutes, so the app opens on the last forecast at once and refreshes in the background.

**Fixed:** wind speed follows the unit setting again.

scenes.match: Draft a note to the team about the hourly view

steps.say:
Here's a draft.

Hi all, the hourly view is ready for testing on staging. The day screen now shows an hourly strip with temperature, rain chance and wind for the next 24 hours, and a tap on an hour opens its details.

What to check: the strip on a small phone, the units setting, and the first launch with no network. Please send anything odd to the release thread by Thursday, so we can ship to the app store next week.

scenes.match: Run the full test suite on the forecast app

steps.say: Running the full suite. It takes a couple of minutes.

args.command: cd forecast && sleep 90 && python3 -m compileall -q src && echo all tests passed
args.title: Run the full test suite

scenes.match: Ship the forecast app to staging

steps.say: I'll start from the deploy script.
There's no deploy script, so I'll build the app first.

args.command: cd forecast && sleep 4 && python3 -m compileall -q src && echo build ok
args.title: Build the app for staging

steps.say: The build is clean. Staging has no deploy script yet, so I stopped there: want me to write one?

scenes.match: What changed in the forecast app since Monday

args.command: cd forecast && git log --oneline --since='7 days ago'
args.title: Commits since Monday

args.command: cd forecast && sleep 2 && python3 -m compileall -q src && echo build ok
args.title: Check that the app still builds

steps.say:
Since Monday:

- **Hourly view.** The day screen has an hourly strip with temperature and rain chance.
- **Faster startup.** Forecasts are cached for ten minutes.
- **Wind units fix.** Wind speed follows the unit setting again.

The build is clean.

scenes.match: Run the type check and the linter on the forecast app

args.command: cd forecast && sleep 3 && python3 -m compileall -q src && echo 'no type errors'
args.title: Run the type check

args.command: cd forecast && sleep 2 && echo 'no issues found'
args.title: Run the linter

steps.say: Both are clean: no type errors, and the linter found nothing.

scenes.match: Add CI checks to the forecast app

steps.say: GitHub Actions it is. Adding the workflow.

args.command: cd forecast && mkdir -p .github/workflows && printf 'name: checks\non: [push]\n' > .github/workflows/checks.yml && echo written
args.title: Add the checks workflow

steps.say: Done: `.github/workflows/checks.yml` runs the checks on every push.
Refreshing the cache from the forecast API.

args.command: cd forecast && sleep 7 && echo cache refreshed
args.title: Refresh the forecast cache

steps.say: The cache is fresh: 24 hours for each saved place.
